killCondition.condition: No signed-in Ideaflow session in the connected Chrome profile. The brief names this the kill condition for this half: never enter credentials; record and stop.
evidence: https://ideaflow.app/ root serves the logged-out marketing page ("Zero-Friction AI Notebook") with a Log in button, not the notebook app.

Clicking Log in redirects to https://auth.ideaflow.app/u/login (Auth0 universal login) presenting an EMPTY email/password form with Google/Apple SSO buttons - no silent session pass-through occurred, so no Auth0 session cookie exists.
localStorage on https://ideaflow.app contains only a PostHog analytics key (ph_phc_...posthog); no @@auth0spajs@@ token-cache keys, confirming the SPA holds no cached access token.
https://ideaflow.io/ is the corporate marketing site (The Intelligence Amplification Company), not the app; no session surface there either.
killCondition.notAttempted: Credentials were never entered; SSO buttons (Continue with Google / Continue with Apple) were never clicked, per the brief and the no-authentication rule.

routesTried.name: documented export UI
routesTried.detail: Any export/settings UI lives behind the authenticated app shell. The unauthenticated root renders only the marketing landing page, so no export control exists to reach.

routesTried.name: observe the app's own network calls (read-only GETs)
routesTried.detail: Full page load of https://ideaflow.app captured 26 requests: Next.js static chunks (/_next/static/...), manifest.json, logo192.png, Google Fonts, and PostHog analytics (us.i.posthog.com, us-assets.i.posthog.com). Zero calls to any notes/graph API - the app makes no data API calls while logged out, so there is no endpoint to replay read-only.

routesTried.name: DOM harvest
routesTried.detail: The rendered DOM is the marketing shell (hero copy, Log in / Install App buttons, empty device mockups). No note content, links, or tags are present in the DOM to harvest.

urlsVisited: https://auth.ideaflow.app/u/login (Auth0 universal login; state param is Auth0 flow state, not a session token)
networkObserved: https://us.i.posthog.com/flags/ (analytics POST by the page itself, not by this probe)
receipt.writesToIdeaflow: none - navigation and read-only inspection only; the sole POST observed (PostHog /flags/) is the page's own analytics bootstrap, not initiated by this probe and not to Ideaflow
receipt.tokensOrCookiesRecorded: none - only cookie/storage KEY NAMES were inspected (a single PostHog key); no values captured; sessionStorage key listing was blocked by the browser tool as sensitive and was not pursued
